name: Social Media Writer
description: Turn Fikr knowledge and uploaded sources into platform-ready LinkedIn, X, Substack, and Medium content.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.hashtagPolicy: Use 3-5 specific hashtags at the end. Never use generic engagement bait.

x.label: X
x.targetLength: A single post is at most 280 characters; a thread is 3-10 focused posts
x.hashtagPolicy: Use at most 2 hashtags, only when they improve discovery.

medium.label: Medium
medium.hashtagPolicy: Use up to 5 topic tags as metadata, never as an inline hashtag block.
